title: Augmont Enterprises IPO Details
intro:
Augmont Enterprises IPO is a book build issue of ₹825.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.79 crore shares aggregating to ₹620.00 crores and offer for sale of 0.26 crore shares aggregating to ₹205.00 crores.

Augmont Enterprises IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 21, 2026 and will close on Aug 25, 2026. The allotment for the Augmont Enterprises IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 27, 2026. Augmont Enterprises IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 31, 2026.

Augmont Enterprises IPO is set issue price band at ₹750 to ₹788 per share. The lot size for an application is 19 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,972 (19 shares) (based on upper price).

Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Augmont Enterprises IPO RHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Augmont Enterprises IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Augmont Enterprises IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Augmont Enterprises IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Augmont Enterprises IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Augmont Enterprises IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: The Augmont Enterprises IPO opens on Fri, Aug 21, 2026 and closes on Tue, Aug 25, 2026.

faqs.answer: Augmont Enterprises IPO lot size is 19 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,972 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Augmont Enterprises IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Augmont Enterprises IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Augmont Enterprises IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Augmont Enterprises IPO will be done on Thursday, August 27, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Aug 28, 2026 . Check the Augmont Enterprises IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Augmont Enterprises IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Augmont Enterprises IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Aug 31, 2026 .
